description_policy: Descriptions are paraphrased capture summaries, not verbatim source text. description_raw is null.
tag_policy: Page-level tags remain separate. Only explicit per-skill list entries and inline section tag prefixes are attached. Null tags mean no section-level mapping was recorded in this batch.

sections.name: Sky Splitter
sections.description_summary: Starts with 500 Energy. Pang enters meditation, then bursts for 350% ATK damage to enemies within 2 tiles. He enters Unyielding Force, draining 150 Energy/s, gaining 60 Haste and 17% ATK, and unlocking Skybreach Strikes. The final of seven strikes deals 150% ATK, stuns for 1.5 s, and prevents non-boss targets from recovering Energy for 5 s. Burst damage and ATK bonus scale through LV 5.

sections.name: Zen Ward
sections.description_summary: Creates a 340% ATK Chi Barrier for 9 s. Pang is unaffected while channeling and while the barrier is active. When the barrier expires, breaks, or is reapplied, it turns into razor leaves dealing 210% ATK to his current target. Shield and damage scale with levels.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Pang's ATK by 9%; adds another 6% while in Unyielding Force. Scales to 15% + 10%.

sections.name: Spirit Sync
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK by 15% for any unit shielded by Chi Barrier. At LV 3, when another allied hero reaches 850 Energy, Pang grants them a Chi Barrier; the same ally can receive it only once every 15 s.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Pang immediately gains a Chi Barrier on entering Unyielding Force and gains 30 DEF Penetration while in that stance.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases shield value provided by Pang. When he shields an ally, that ally gains Phys & Magic DEF for 8 s; higher ranks also heal for a percentage of the shield value.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Reduces damage taken for 20 s at battle start, then increases damage dealt for 20 s; refine adds Healing and Haste.

sections.name: Intel Chase
sections.description_summary: Evie teleports to the symmetrical enemy tile and enters concealment/invincibility while gathering Detection. Allied Ultimates reduce Detection. When revealed, she interrogates the enemy with the highest cumulative damage, dealing damage each second and immobilizing them; if she has intel on that target, she also silences them.

sections.name: Pointed Proof
sections.description_summary: Permanently reduces Magic DEF after an enemy's intel is completed; if all surviving enemy heroes are investigated, it applies an additional team-wide Magic DEF reduction.

sections.name: Foretold Favor
sections.description_summary: Sends a quill to the rearmost ally, then every 3 s switches to the ally with the highest cumulative damage, healing them and increasing ATK. Damage milestones send healing orbs to two other weakest allies.

sections.name: Tactical Briefing
sections.description_summary: The excerpt confirms a Debuff (Global) tag, but ends inside this equipment section; the remaining effect description is not captured.

capture_status_notes: The returned excerpt ends inside Exclusive Equipment and omits later progression sections.

sections.name: Stellar Flare
sections.description_summary: Summons a Star that damages nearby enemies; supercharges all Stars, causing area damage and stun, followed by 6 s burn damage. Up to three Stars can exist, with placement replacement rules.

sections.name: Gravitic Maw
sections.description_summary: Each Star creates a Planet on an adjacent tile; planets orbit, damaging enemies, while the active cast pulls enemies near Stars and Black Holes toward the nearest one.

sections.name: Darklight Pulse
sections.description_summary: Fires beams along three lines covering the most enemies, damages them, grants Aster a shield based on actual damage, and reduces enemy shields.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Expands Gravitic Maw pull range to 3 tiles; before Stars convert to Black Holes, Aster gains Energy recovery efficiency. After conversion, he becomes permanently invincible until he is the last surviving hero on his team.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides Energy recovery per second; after three Ultimates, ATK increases. Higher ranks add true damage to all enemies on each Ultimate.

capture_status_notes: Hero Focus and Exclusive Equipment are omitted, so this profile remains partial.

sections.name: Whirlwind Swing
sections.description_summary: Rushes to a selected tile, damages adjacent enemies and knocks them back. Collisions with allies, enemies, terrain or map borders deal additional damage and stun; automatic targeting prioritizes the tile causing the most collisions.

sections.name: Repel Sweep
sections.description_summary: A melee strike knocks an enemy back; collision causes additional damage and stun.

capture_status_notes: The returned excerpt does not contain the rest of the kit or progression sections.

sections.name: Pounding Blow
sections.description_summary: Spiny is summoned at battle start. Active cast summons Smashy to damage adjacent enemies and knock them airborne; Smashy inherits Florabelle's HP and has its own control vulnerability. Higher level can coordinate all three Bulbsprites.

sections.name: Overgrowth
sections.description_summary: Feeds a Bulbsprite to transform it into a giant for 8 s, granting Haste and Life Drain; targeting order is Smashy, Swifty, Spiny.

sections.name: Tiny Sharpshooter
sections.description_summary: Summons Swifty in the backline; repeated cast while Swifty is present triggers Rapid Fire.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK, with an additional bonus while at least two summons are present.

sections.name: Protective Blessing
sections.description_summary: Allied summons enter with a permanent shield based on Florabelle's ATK.

capture_status_notes: Enhance Force, Season Charm and Rivalry Mode were not included in the returned excerpt.

sections.name: Savage Slash
sections.description_summary: Destroys obstacles within 2 tiles of the target position, deals damage based on enemy HP and knocks enemies airborne.

sections.name: Rallying Roar
sections.description_summary: Opening passive sends illusions in a 5-tile-wide wedge toward the enemy side, damaging enemies and destroying obstacles. Allies passed by the illusions gain max HP, Life Drain, Haste and movement speed. Active cast buffs allies within 2 tiles.

capture_status_notes: Remaining skills and progression sections were not included in the returned excerpt.

sections.name: Grand Finale
sections.description_summary: Sylphira builds beats over time and gains ATK/Haste when the score is complete. Active cast glides to the area with the most enemies, damages them, creates a Harmonic Domain, silences enemies inside and makes Sylphira unaffected while inside.

capture_status_notes: The returned excerpt ends during the Ultimate; other abilities and progression sections remain uncaptured.

sections.name: Whirlwind Wrath
sections.description_summary: Spins Mountain's Roar, dealing damage to adjacent enemies for 4 s; LV 3 grants damage immunity while spinning.

sections.name: Ferocious Roar
sections.description_summary: Taunts enemies within 2 tiles and reduces their Phys DEF for 9 s.

sections.name: Indomitable
sections.description_summary: Brutus is immune to the first fatal blow he receives.

capture_status_notes: The excerpt ends at the Indomitable heading; later sections are absent.

sections.name: Winter Anthem
sections.description_summary: Opening passive reduces Haste by 40 and range by 2 tiles for all units except Alna. Active blizzard removes enemy Haste buffs, deals periodic damage and converts some damage taken by Alna/Winter Warrior into healing over time.

sections.name: Shared Resolve
sections.description_summary: Selects an ally in Alna's row as Winter Warrior, protecting them from Winter Anthem's Haste reduction and increasing their max HP. Active strike damages enemies and restores HP to Alna and the Winter Warrior.

sections.name: Wild Whirl
sections.description_summary: Repeated spear strikes damage nearby enemies and reduce their Haste.

capture_status_notes: Hero Focus, Exclusive Equipment, Enhance Force, Season Charm and Rivalry Mode were not in the returned excerpt.

sections.name: Whispering Tempest
sections.description_summary: Creates a storm around the frontmost enemy, reducing Haste and dealing periodic damage to enemies within 2 tiles.

sections.name: Stormbound Retribution
sections.description_summary: Opening link connects the nearest and farthest enemies; 70% of damage taken by one is transferred to the other, with caps and break conditions.

sections.name: Turbulent Resurgence
sections.description_summary: When the chain breaks, heals all allies and recasts the chain, up to three casts per battle. Higher levels add stun.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: The protected target becomes unaffected. LV 2 increases chain casts, adds max-HP reduction to transferred damage, and gives Zephyr's Embrace to the ally dealing the most damage when the chain breaks.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Grants an opening melee-damage bonus and ranged-damage reduction for the ally one tile in front; higher ranks add Energy on Hit.

capture_status_notes: Hero Focus and any missing base-skill section were not visible in the returned excerpt.
